name: kr.aljal.k-data/public-data
title: 알잘 공공데이터
description: 공공데이터로 정리한 공공시설 · 버리는 비용 정보. Korean public facilities and disposal costs from public data.

tools.name: get_public_overview
tools.description: Aljal Public Data (알잘 공공데이터): Overview of the public facilities and local disposal information covered, grouped as outings (나들이 갈 때), public places (공공 시설 갈 때), sports (운동하러 갈 때) and disposal (버릴 때). With a region, the same grouping for that region: which kinds exist there and how many places, with the region page URL. Results are in Korean.

region.description: Optional Korean region name: 시도 (서울, 경기, 부산) or 시군구 (강남구, 수원시, 분당). 지역.

tools.name: explore_outings
tools.description: Aljal Public Data (알잘 공공데이터): Outings: recreation forests (자연휴양림) with the shared national reservation calendar, public campgrounds, highway rest areas (휴게소) by route and direction with menu price ranges, and public leisure sports (승마 · 클라이밍 · 활쏘기 · 스케이트 · 사격). With no inputs: the kinds in this group, what each answers, and the conditions it can be narrowed by. With a kind: a nationwide summary of that kind. With a region, conditions or words: matching places (default 10), each with an id for get_place, a one-line summary and the page URL. Results are in Korean.

kind.description: foresttrip (휴양림), camping (공공 캠핑장), reststop (고속도로 휴게소), leisure (레포츠 체험).

region.description: Optional Korean region name: 시도 (서울, 경기, 부산) or 시군구 (강남구, 수원시, 분당). 지역.

filters.description: Optional condition keys, all must hold. Valid keys per kind are listed in the result `next.filters` (e.g. free, walkin, indoor, pets, monday). 조건.

query.description: Optional words to match against place names and addresses, in Korean, e.g. "장충", "글로벌도서관". 이름 · 주소 낱말.

limit.description: Optional number of places to return, default 10, max 30.

from.description: Optional offset to continue a list (`nextFrom` from the previous result).

route.description: Rest areas only: Korean highway route name, e.g. "경부선", "영동선". 노선.

direction.description: Rest areas only: direction as 상행 / 하행 or a destination such as "부산", "서울". 방향.

menu.description: Rest areas only: a dish name in Korean to compare prices across rest areas, e.g. "우동", "돈가스". 메뉴.

tools.name: explore_civic_places
tools.description: Aljal Public Data (알잘 공공데이터): Public places: museums and art museums (국공립 · 대학 박물관 · 미술관, admission fee and closing days), public libraries (loan limits, opening hours, closing days), and public indoor playgrounds including Seoul kids cafes (서울형 키즈카페). With no inputs: the kinds in this group, what each answers, and the conditions it can be narrowed by. With a kind: a nationwide summary of that kind. With a region, conditions or words: matching places (default 10), each with an id for get_place, a one-line summary and the page URL. Results are in Korean.

filters.description: Optional condition keys, all must hold. Valid keys per kind are listed in the result `next.filters` (e.g. free, walkin, indoor, pets, monday). 조건.

query.description: Optional words to match against place names and addresses, in Korean, e.g. "장충", "글로벌도서관". 이름 · 주소 낱말.

limit.description: Optional number of places to return, default 10, max 30.

from.description: Optional offset to continue a list (`nextFrom` from the previous result).

tools.name: explore_sports_facilities
tools.description: Aljal Public Data (알잘 공공데이터): Public sports facilities opened by local governments and public institutions: how to reserve (online, phone, or no reservation), whether free, indoor or outdoor, open at night. With no inputs: the kinds in this group, what each answers, and the conditions it can be narrowed by. With a kind: a nationwide summary of that kind. With a region, conditions or words: matching places (default 10), each with an id for get_place, a one-line summary and the page URL. Results are in Korean.

kind.description: parkgolf (파크골프장), golf (골프장 · 골프연습장), tennis (테니스장), futsal (풋살장), soccer (축구장), badminton (배드민턴장), pool (수영장), basketball (농구장), gym (헬스장), baseball (야구장), jokgu (족구장), pingpong (탁구장), inline (인라인장), bowling (볼링장), squash (스쿼시장).

region.description: Optional Korean region name: 시도 (서울, 경기, 부산) or 시군구 (강남구, 수원시, 분당). 지역.

filters.description: Optional condition keys, all must hold. Valid keys per kind are listed in the result `next.filters` (e.g. free, walkin, indoor, pets, monday). 조건.

query.description: Optional words to match against place names and addresses, in Korean, e.g. "장충", "글로벌도서관". 이름 · 주소 낱말.

limit.description: Optional number of places to return, default 10, max 30.

from.description: Optional offset to continue a list (`nextFrom` from the previous result).

tools.name: check_disposal
tools.description: Aljal Public Data (알잘 공공데이터): Disposal information by item and local area (시군구): standard garbage bag prices (종량제봉투, also per liter), food waste bag prices, bulky waste collection fees by item (대형폐기물: 소파, 침대, 장롱…), whether an appliance is collected free (폐가전 무상수거, with the official yes/no list for tricky items), and where unused medicine goes (폐의약품). With no inputs: the four kinds. With an item: the rule and the nationwide fee range. With a region: that area's prices and drop-off counts with the page URL. Results are in Korean.

kind.description: trashbag (종량제봉투 가격), bulkywaste (대형폐기물 수거 비용), ewastebin (폐가전 수거함 · 무상수거), medbin (폐의약품).

item.description: Optional item in Korean, e.g. "소파", "냉장고", "선풍기", "전동침대", "알약", "주사바늘". 물건.

region.description: Optional Korean 시군구 or 시도, e.g. "군포시", "송파구", "부산". 동네.

place.description: Optional apartment complex name in Korean to check whether an e-waste bin is registered there, e.g. "도곡렉슬". 아파트 단지.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Aljal Public Data (알잘 공공데이터): A short summary of one place: kind, region, address, and what applies (free or paid, how to reserve, indoor or outdoor, pets, open on Mondays), with the data date and the page URL. Phone numbers, the place's own reservation dates, fee amounts and opening hours are on that page. Takes an id from another tool, or a Korean place name (optionally with a region). When several places share the name, the result lists them. Results are in Korean.

id.description: An id from another tool, e.g. "tennis/장충테니스장".

name.description: A place name in Korean, e.g. "용인자연휴양림", "선산휴게소 상행", "의왕시글로벌도서관". 곳 이름.

region.description: Optional Korean region name: 시도 (서울, 경기, 부산) or 시군구 (강남구, 수원시, 분당). 지역.

tools.name: make_saved_list_link
tools.description: Aljal Public Data (알잘 공공데이터): Make one link that opens the given places on 알잘 공공데이터, where the user can save them to their own list and keep track of them. Takes the `saveIds` returned by the other tools (up to 50). Returns the link.
